question.question: Can a delayed genuine pre-vote grant carrying the same numeric term as a newly entered real campaign count toward leadership before a majority of real vote grants arrives?
question.importance: Mixing pre-vote and real-vote support would allow authority acquisition from replies that do not record an actual vote. The checked consequence is local real-campaign eligibility, not a conflicting-leader or client witness.

candidate.rationale: Create an independent local response-type eligibility obligation; the prior lower-term result does not cover this equal-term case.

obligation.description: A real candidate must not acquire leadership using pre-vote grants, even when their numeric term matches; a majority of delivered real vote grants for that campaign is necessary.

scope.description: One actual pre-vote campaign advances through a pre-vote majority into real candidacy; a third pre-vote grant with matching numeric term is delivered before real self and peer grants.
assumptions: Three fixed voters, PreVote enabled and AsyncStorageWrites; sequential RawNode calls and FIFO local work.

MemoryStorage models no-crash storage completion; real grant capture verifies actual stored term/vote.
excluded: General consensus correctness, physical crash safety or client consequences.
General pre-vote liveness, clock/lease assumptions and arbitrary candidate interactions.

grounding.derivation: The candidate consumer comment expressly requires responses corresponding to its candidacy and notes stale pre-vote replies can occur in the same term during real candidacy. Step grants pre-votes without recording a real vote; their response term comes from the request. Majority VoteResult defines winning support. These sources yield the local duty that a real campaign requires real grants, not same-term pre-vote grants.
grounding.applicability: Fixed three-voter real campaign entered through the implementation pre-vote path.
alternatives: Pre-vote majority authorizes starting a real campaign, not immediate leadership.
A same-term pre-vote response need not be excluded by the numeric term gate; the response-type gate is the relevant protection.

bindings.description: stepCandidate selects the response type corresponding to pre-candidate versus real candidate before polling grants.

associations.rationale: Real campaign majority cannot include a pre-vote reply that merely shares its term.

feedback.answered: The consumer explicitly distinguishes pre-vote and real-vote response types because stale pre-vote replies can arrive in the real term. Pre-vote response terms are copied from future-term requests without recording a real vote. The new fixed driver traverses that actual producer path and counts only delivered real grants independently.
